executiveSummary: A lethal earthquake in the Nagqu area of Tibet killed at least 16 people, injured 76, collapsed hundreds of homes, and forced more than 12,000 evacuations; transport and communications were disrupted and cold-weather exposure is a concern for displaced households. View Article A multi-day storm system triggered severe flooding across the U.S. Four Corners region with rooftop rescues, hundreds of home evacuations, power outages, hazardous reentry conditions (downed lines, gas leaks), and around 2,000 people affected near Farmington, NM. View Article In Utah's Washington County (Hurricane), floodwaters entered roughly 80 homes and 50 RVs while tornadoes elsewhere damaged roofs and power lines, prompting local emergency actions. View Article Typhoon Champi in Taiwan left one person dead, hundreds injured (reporting varies from 170+ to ~350), and knocked out power to about 280,000 households; schools, offices, and flights were widely disrupted. Supporting Report View Article An emerging Tropical Storm Vance off Mexico's Pacific coast poses flash flood and mudslide risks to western states if rainfall intensifies; preparedness is advised for steep-terrain communities. View Article Additional monitored hazards include coastal flooding and strong winds along the U.S. Eastern Seaboard, a strong offshore earthquake near Vanuatu that prompted a tsunami warning (no immediate damage reported), and flash flooding affecting ~100 households in Phuket, Thailand. outlook72h: Four Corners (U.S.): Residual flooding, debris, and utility hazards likely to complicate reentry; localized heavy rain could trigger renewed flash flooding in vulnerable corridors-maintain flood watch and road closure contingencies. Supporting Report Tibet (China): Aftershocks possible; prioritize winterized shelter, heating, and structural safety assessments before reoccupation. Source Taiwan: Recovery operations ongoing; monitor for secondary landslides and stream rises in steep terrain even as conditions gradually improve. Source Western Mexico: Tropical Storm Vance may enhance rainfall-flash flooding/mudslides remain plausible in coastal and mountainous zones; activate early-warning and slope monitoring where feasible. regionalTrends: Late-season Pacific systems are sustaining flood risk across the U.S. Southwest, with saturated ground conditions amplifying impacts from additional rainfall.
Western Pacific typhoons continue to cause island-wide service disruption and landslide risk in mountainous terrain.
